{{Quote|Durni are small creatures that live mainly on the planet Corellia. They shed their fur quite often which then accumulates into balls of hair. Many people think dust balls in their homes look like these balls of fur, hence the name Dust Durni.|[[Yawse Felsiy]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:YF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Yawse Felsiy|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
'''Dust durni''' was a slang term used to refer to a large pile of dust. Its name refers to the [[durni]], whose soft fur coat may have reminded someone of the soft nature of dust.<ref name="SWG:YF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was visiting the [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] searched the station for all the dust durnis on the station, cleaning them up as they went. For removing them all, they were rewarded with a [[Feather Duster|feather duster]] by [[Yawse Felsiy]]. Another spacer later performed a similar task on [[Nova Orion Station]].<ref name="SWG:DD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Dust Durni}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dust durnis appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dust durnis were added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|Chapter 8]]" on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>

Dust durnis were an interactive object that players could collect.<ref name="SWG:DD" /> The name is a reference to the term "dust bunnies" here on Earth, as durnis and rabbits are similar in appearance.
